sources.title: Rampart - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Rampart is a 14.7 MB quantized ONNX token-classification model for client-side PII detection and redaction. Fine-tuned from MiniLM-L6-H384 with a 35-label BIO head covering 17 entity types, it supports 7 Latin-script languages. Designed to run in browsers via ONNX Runtime Web and Transformers.js at 6.6 ms p50 latency.
